passages.passage: # Trump weighs another strike on Iran as Hormuz shipping risks mount. Returns to Washington after overseas trip.
- Reports Trump is in no rush to decide. Oil traders are watching whether the larger flow through Hormuz holds as reports of attacks on ships raise fresh concerns.

Geopolitics is building as President Trump is heading back to Washington after wrapping up talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen. Ukraine was a focus coming out of the meetings.

passages.under: With Xi, Iran, Hormuz, Taiwan and trade.
passages.passage: Trump said he and Xi agreed that Iran should fully reopen the Strait of Hormuz and should not acquire a nuclear weapon. Trump also urged China to help end the war in Ukraine. Beijing’s readout emphasized Taiwan and Xi’s call for better communication on trade and economic issues.

passages.under: With Putin, a possible path to ending the Ukraine war.
passages.passage: Ukraine came up in Trump’s one-on-one with Putin and again in the three-way talks. Afterward, US envoy Jared Kushner said Russia was comfortable with the idea of NATO-style security guarantees for Ukraine. Putin separately ruled out direct talks with Kyiv, citing Ukraine’s strike on the Kerch Bridge

passages.under: Trump is weighing his options on Iran
passages.passage: #### Trump is weighing his options on Iran

passages.under: Trump is weighing his options on Iran
passages.passage: US President Donald Trump is considering another strike on Iran, Israel’s Channel 12 reported, citing an Israeli source. The broadcaster said Trump is in no rush to make a decision and that any strike would be carried out in cooperation with Israel. It said potential targets could include nuclear facilities, infrastructure and senior officials.

passages.under: Kushner says Trump is open to Ukraine security guarantees
passages.passage: #### Kushner says Trump is open to Ukraine security guarantees

passages.under: Kushner says Trump is open to Ukraine security guarantees
passages.passage: On Ukraine, US special envoy Jared Kushner said Trump came away from the Shenzhen meeting believing peace was achievable. Kushner said there had been progress on a postwar economic plan and that Russia had agreed to engage in a multilateral format with European countries. He added that Trump wants Europe alongside him in reaching a deal.
